title.narrative: Strengthening HIV prevention, reduction of tuberculosis and COVID-19 morbidity and mortality - Botswana (01-Jan-2022-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Botswana, TB/HIV, Botswana-Ministry of Health (Ministry of Health)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality from 28/100,000 population in 2019 to 10/100,000 population by 2024. To reduce TB incidence from 253/100,000 population in 2019 to 195/100,000 population in 2024.. To reduce new HIV infections from 4.39 per 1000 population in 2020 to 3.22 per 1000 population by 2024. To reduce AIDS related deaths from 211 per 100000 population in 2020 to 175 per 100000 population by 2024. The objectives of this program are: Reduce TB-related deaths among people living with HIV by 75% from 56 per 100,000 in 2019 to 14 per 100,000 by 2023. Reduce HIV related stigma and discrimination from 13.2% in 2013 to less than 5% by 2023 among PLHIV and KPs. To reach 70% of adolescent girls and young women with a standardised package of HIV services by 2024.. To achieve over 90% HIV prevention, treatment, care and support service coverage targets among key populations by 2023. To increase TB treatment succes rate (all forms - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases) from 81% in 2019 to 90% and above by 2024. To increase TB treatment coverage (all form of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed) from 74% in 2019 to 90% and above by 2024. Over 95% of people living with HIV know their HIV status by 2023. Over 90% of People Living with HIV on ART by 2023. Over 86% of PLHIV are virally suppressed by 2023
